intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Kabuto/Black Kabuto sniper, multiple Pop Greens with distinct documented behavior, traps and Observation awakening. Long-range precision and plant lane control. No invented continuous Haki mastery, free flying, or magical damage aura. Named plants must correspond to implemented behavior. Sogeking is a persona, not a supernatural transformation. Supplemental research focus: Focus fresh source extraction on canonical named Pop Greens and their distinct effects, explicitly separating Film-only plants and post-Wano appearances from manga techniques established through Wano. Verify Black Kabuto and Growth behavior. Retain claims only when supported by read source content; label missing facts as gaps. Do not infer game mechanics or numbers from canon. Research quality requirement: Do not copy a mixed-canon index list as verified manga techniques. For each named Pop Green record its concrete effect and manga-through-Wano support individually. Omit Film Z-only Nemuri So, Hanabibana, Baku Bokkuri and other anime/film/game-only or post-Wano techniques. Read targeted Kuro Kabuto equipment details, and report retrieval gaps instead of inventing them.
